requiredFindings.title: A floor-observation refusal is returned before the carrier is classified
requiredFindings.failureScenario: floor_step returns observe_floor's refusal before classify_carrier. A floor that does not decode becomes FloorMalformed, and an unreadable floor becomes host I/O, while a complete format 1 or 2 carrier or a format-3 footprint has not been classified. Item 3 step 3 classifies before any floor decision, and F46 applies whatever the floor is. Required: hold the floor observation, classify first, and return F46 or the migration-footprint row when classification refuses. Apply the malformed-floor quarantine (LedgerCorrupt, nothing written) and a floor read failure only after classification has admitted no carrier or a current format 3 carrier.

requiredFindings.title: Not a database and MigrationRequiresValidation use the wrong item 8 rows
requiredFindings.failureScenario: classify_read_error maps SQLITE_NOTADB to Footprint (MIGRATION.CORRUPT) and MigrationRequiresValidation to Inherited (F46). Item 8 and the forbidden-substitutes line give MIGRATION.CORRUPT only to a format-3 footprint or a violated published generation boundary. Bytes SQLite will not open are neither. MigrationRequiresValidation is migrated_from disagreeing with the inherited schema, or MAX(grantGeneration) of grant_journal not equal to first_generation - 1, and that boundary is already the migration-footprint row. A consistent migrated format 3 still takes F46 through inherited_format on PublishedCurrent, and format 1 and format 2 stay on F46. Required: map bytes that are not a database to host I/O with the other read failures, and map MigrationRequiresValidation to the migration-footprint row.
